selected.scope_excerpt:

selected.title: Add new properties for the path and arguments separately
selected.scope_excerpt: [](https://oss.issuehunt.io/r/sindresorhus/ps-list/issues/7) Currently there's `process.cmd`, but it includes both the path and arguments. Would be useful for https://github.com/sindresorhus/fkill-cli/issues/16 to have separate `process.path` and `process.args` properties. Context: > I looked into this more, and I might have a solution to get the arguments without the full path. It seems `ps -o pid -o comm` returns the full path without arguments and `ps -o pid -o command` returns with arguments. So we could get both columns and just diff them to get the arguments. I think this should be added as a new property in [`ps-list`](https://github.com/sindresorhus/ps-list). So we could add an `args` property with just the arguments
